response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with strong full-stack, DevOps, and systems background, plus notable geospatial/GIS project experience (GISCollective, Green Map). However, his core technical stack is overwhelmingly JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js/DLang, with only minimal and dated C/C++ exposure (2014-2015) and no evidence of Rust, distributed routing systems, or navigation/traffic-tile pipeline work, making him a weak match for a role centered on modern C++/Rust routing tile engineering.
strengths: Genuine geospatial domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map GIS platforms
Strong systems/DevOps background including Linux, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and distributed micro-services (Sociomantic)
Demonstrated versatility, self-driven learning, and ability to pick up new stacks quickly
concerns: C++ experience is minimal, dated (2014-2015), and not in a routing/navigation context
No mentioned Rust experience at all
No direct experience with routing tile pipelines, traffic data integration, or navigation guidance QA
